contract.syntax: Opt-in SET VAR/SET VARIABLE exact named copies; existing KCL_NO_WAIT status and scripted reply precedence
contract.values: Scalar PATH/QUEUE_TYPE, whole collection banks, complete indexed cells and named ARRAY components with identical concrete schemas
contract.partial: Preserve valid partial PATH data and uninitialized queue state through the existing logical codecs; ordinary data copies remain complete-only
contract.budget: Preflight source/receiver descriptor and content counts, at most 32767 units each; charge both selections before snapshotting and require unchanged admitted counts after checkpoints
contract.target: Retain target location/store/root/selected cell and recheck detached whole-owner aliases, timers and protection after charges
contract.source: Resolve the current named source after final charges; allow replacement with exact schema and equal admitted count; compiled source data allowed
contract.publication: Validate both logical values, including owned-cell independence, before publishing; retain receiver cells and compatible headers, replace PATH node lists and clear only copied queue buffer links
contract.persistence: Existing typed context JSON retains values, queue sequences, creation metadata and command history, with no queue buffer links, active aliases or task restoration

boundaries: No incomplete collection prefixes or paused-local collection roots
No FILE copying, resource fields, aggregate literals, schema conversion or implicit reshape
No rollback of earlier independent callback/checkpoint effects
Offline authored command contract; no native/controller/strict equivalence
